title: Product Profile: Horticulture
subtitle: 2025 Edition
org: Kenya Export Promotion and Branding Agency
intro: Kenya's horticulture sector is Kenya's leading non-traditional export earner, spanning fresh cut flowers, ornamental plants, fresh and processed vegetables and fruit. It supports hundreds of thousands of smallholder farmers and large-scale producers, and is anchored on exports to the European Union and the United Kingdom, which absorb the bulk of Kenya's premium horticultural produce.

This profile examines Kenya's trade in horticulture (HS Chapters 06 to 08: live trees and plants, cut flowers and ornamental foliage; edible vegetables and certain roots and tubers; and edible fruit and nuts), based on trade values reported to the International Trade Centre (ITC). The analysis covers the period 2021 to 2025.

Cut flowers, especially roses, avocado, French beans, mangoes, pineapples and macadamia nuts form the backbone of the export basket. Presenting this family as a single portfolio provides a clearer picture of the size, growth and market orientation of Kenya's horticultural exports.
